chunks: He said: And al-Rida (peace be upon him) said: Whoever is unable to find a way to expiate his sins, then let him increase in sending blessings upon Muhammad and his family, for indeed it thoroughly destroys sins.

key_terms.الصلاة على محمد وآله: Sending blessings upon Muhammad and his family (salawat) — a devotional act of invoking divine blessings
key_terms.تهدم الذنوب هدما: Destroys sins thoroughly — emphatic expression using cognate accusative to stress completeness of destruction
key_terms.يكفر: Expiates, atones for — the process of compensating for or erasing sins through righteous deeds

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Rida say about the power of salawat to destroy sins?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (AS) prescribes salawat (sending blessings upon Muhammad and his family) as a powerful means of expiating sins for those who are unable to find other means of atonement. The Imam uses the emphatic construction 'destroys sins thoroughly' (tahdim al-dhunub hadman), employing the maf'ul mutlaq (cognate accusative) for rhetorical intensification, indicating that salawat does not merely reduce sins but demolishes them completely.
